scenarios.title: 起床 Morning
scenarios.tip: 起床是每天第一次英语输入，语气要轻快。拉开窗帘时说 Open the curtain，抱宝宝时说 Good morning! 先用固定的问候语建立仪式感，宝宝听到固定句子会形成条件反射。

phrases.en: Good morning! Wake up, sleepyhead!
Did you sleep well?
Let's open the curtain. Wow, it's a sunny day!
phrases.cn: 我们拉开窗帘。哇，今天是大晴天！

phrases.en: Let's stretch your arms. Stretch, stretch!
phrases.cn: 伸伸你的小胳膊。伸一伸！

phrases.en: Can you stand up? Let me give you a big hug!
phrases.cn: 能自己站起来吗？让我抱一个大！

phrases.en: Let's change your diaper first.
Are you hungry? Let's go get some milk.
Say good morning to Daddy!

scenarios.title: 吃饭 Mealtime
scenarios.tip: 吃饭时反复用同一套句式最有效：先用 Try some...，再问 Do you like it?。不催促不强迫，让英语和吃这件事绑定愉快体验。描述食物的颜色和味道，就是最好的词汇输入。

phrases.en: It's time for breakfast!
Are you hungry? Let's wash our hands first.
Sit in your high chair, please.
Try some egg. It's yummy!
The carrot is orange. The broccoli is green.
phrases.cn: 胡萝卜是橙色的，西兰花是绿色的。

phrases.en: Blow on it... it's hot! Hot hot hot!
Do you want more? More rice?
You're such a good eater!
All done? Let's wipe your mouth.
phrases.cn: 吃完了吗？我们擦擦嘴巴。

scenarios.title: 洗澡 Bath Time
scenarios.tip: 洗澡是宝宝最放松的时刻，也是输入身体部位词汇的黄金时间。玩 Wash your tummy! 的游戏，配合泼水声 Splash，宝宝会咯咯笑着记住这些词。

phrases.en: Bath time! Let's take off your clothes.
phrases.cn: 洗澡时间到！我们把衣服脱掉。

phrases.en: Test the water... it's just right.
Get in the tub. Careful!
Let's wash your tummy. Scrub scrub scrub!
phrases.cn: 洗洗你的小肚子。搓搓搓！

phrases.en: Wash your arms... wash your legs...
Where is your belly button? Here it is!
phrases.cn: 你的肚脐眼在哪？在这里！

phrases.en: Splash! The ducky swims in the water.
phrases.cn: 哗啦！小鸭子在水里游泳。

phrases.en: Bath time is over. Time to get out!

scenarios.title: 穿衣 Dressing
scenarios.tip: 穿衣时自然输入衣服名称和颜色，这比指着卡片教有效得多。让宝宝自己伸手说 Arms up!，训练配合度，还能顺带学会身体部位。

phrases.en: Let's get dressed! Arms up!
phrases.cn: 我们穿衣服啦！小手举起来！

phrases.en: This is your shirt. It's yellow!
One arm in... two arms in. There we go!
phrases.cn: 一只手伸进去……两只手都伸进去了。好啦！

phrases.en: Let's put on your pants. Feet first!
Where are your socks? Let's find them.
phrases.cn: 你的袜子呢？我们找找看。

phrases.en: Zip up your jacket. Zip zip zip!
All dressed! How handsome!

scenarios.title: 玩耍 Play Time
scenarios.tip: 陪玩时用解说员方式说话，描述宝宝正在做的事（You're stacking blocks!）。不用要求回应，磨耳朵重在持续。游戏指令类句子（Come here / Give me five）宝宝最容易先输出。

phrases.en: What do you want to play with?
Let's stack the blocks. One, two, three... wow, so tall!
phrases.cn: 我们来搭积木。一、二、三……哇，好高！

phrases.en: Uh-oh, it fell down!
Roll the ball to Mommy!
Where is your teddy bear? Is it under the chair?
phrases.cn: 你的泰迪熊在哪？在椅子下面吗？

phrases.en: Come here! Give Mommy five!
Let's read this book together. Sit next to me.
phrases.cn: 我们一起看这本书，坐我旁边。

phrases.en: It's time to clean up. Put the toys in the box.
phrases.cn: 该收拾了，把玩具放进箱子里。

scenarios.title: 外出 Outing
scenarios.tip: 出门是最大的天然课堂：红绿灯、小汽车、小狗、树叶，全都是活教材。指着实物说英文，配合夸张语气和拟声词（Beep beep! Woof woof!），宝宝印象最深。

phrases.en: Let's go outside! Put on your shoes.
phrases.cn: 我们出去玩啦！穿上鞋子。

phrases.en: Hold Mommy's hand, please.
Look! The light is green. Let's cross the street.
Wow, a big truck! Beep beep!
Look at the doggy. It says woof woof!
The leaves are falling. Autumn is here.
phrases.cn: 树叶落下来了，秋天到了。

phrases.en: Do you want to go on the slide? One more time?
phrases.cn: 你想玩滑梯吗？再来一次？

phrases.en: Say bye-bye to the park!

scenarios.title: 睡前 Bedtime
scenarios.tip: 睡前是固定英语仪式的最佳时机：洗澡→刷牙→读绘本→唱摇篮曲→关灯说 Good night。每天顺序一致、语言一致，宝宝会有强烈安全感，英语也自然成了生活的一部分。

phrases.en: It's bedtime. Time to sleep!
Let's pick a book. Which one do you want?
phrases.cn: 挑一本绘本吧，你想看哪本？

phrases.en: Snuggle up next to Mommy.
Close your eyes. Sweet dreams.
Mommy will sing a lullaby for you.
Say good night to the moon!
Good night, my little angel.

scenarios.title: 认识身体 Body Parts
scenarios.tip: 两岁前后是身体认知敏感期，Head, Shoulders, Knees and Toes 这首儿歌配合这个场景效果翻倍。玩 Where is your nose? 的问答游戏，宝宝指对了就大声夸奖。

phrases.en: Where is your nose? Point to your nose!
phrases.cn: 鼻子在哪里？指指你的鼻子！

phrases.en: These are your eyes. You can see with them!
phrases.cn: 这是你的眼睛，你能用它们看东西！

phrases.en: Touch your head. Clap your hands!
How many fingers? One, two, three, four, five!
Stomp your feet! Stamp stamp stamp!
Wiggle your toes! Tickly tickly!
You have two ears, just like a bunny!
phrases.cn: 你有两只耳朵，就像小兔子！

scenarios.title: 动物园 Zoo
scenarios.tip: 逛动物园是最兴奋的英语课堂！看到动物先说名字再模仿叫声，比如看到狮子说 A lion! Roar!。宝宝对动物天生有兴趣，配合动作和声音，词汇记忆效果极佳。

phrases.en: Let's go to the zoo today!
Look! A lion! The lion says ROAR!
The elephant has a long trunk.
phrases.cn: 大象有一条长长的鼻子。

phrases.en: The giraffe has a very long neck.
Look at the monkey! It's climbing the tree.
The panda is eating bamboo. Yum yum!
phrases.cn: 熊猫在吃竹子呢，真好吃！

phrases.en: The zebra has black and white stripes.
Can you hop like a kangaroo?
phrases.cn: 你能像袋鼠一样跳一跳吗？

phrases.en: The tiger is sleeping. Shh, be quiet.
Wow, look at that big bear!

scenarios.title: 路上的动物 Animals Outside
scenarios.tip: 散步路上遇到的动物是日常最高频的英语输入机会：小狗、小猫、小鸟、蝴蝶都是活教材。看到就随口说出来，不用刻意安排，自然重复几次宝宝就记住了。

phrases.en: Look, a cat! The cat says meow.
A dog is barking. Woof woof!
There's a bird in the tree. Tweet tweet!
Look at the butterfly! It's so pretty.
A little ant is walking on the ground.
The squirrel is running up the tree.
Look, two pigeons on the bench!
A snail is so slow. Slow slow slow!

scenarios.title: 夸奖与鼓励 Praise
scenarios.tip: 夸奖要具体、要及时。与其只说 Good，不如说 You did it yourself!。宝宝的成就感会让他更愿意开口。避免说 No no no，多用正向指令（Walk slowly 而不是 Don't run）。

phrases.en: You did it! All by yourself!
What a good job! Mommy is so proud of you.
phrases.cn: 做得真好！妈妈为你骄傲。

phrases.en: Yay! Give me five!
You tried so hard. Well done!
Thank you for helping, my little helper!
Don't worry. Mommy is right here.
It's okay. Let's try again together.

scenarios.title: 规则与安全 Rules
scenarios.tip: 立规矩时保持语气平静、句子简短。固定说 Hands are not for hitting，比长篇大论有效。危险场景用夸张表情配短句（Hot! Danger!），宝宝会快速把词和危险建立联系。

phrases.en: No, no. We don't touch the plug. It's dangerous!
Gentle! Pet the kitty gently, like this.
phrases.cn: 要轻轻的！像这样轻轻摸小猫。

phrases.en: Hot! Don't touch. It's very hot!
We walk inside the house. Run outside, okay?
phrases.cn: 在屋里要走路，在外面才能跑，好吗？

phrases.en: Use your words, not your hands.
phrases.cn: 用嘴巴说出来，不要动手。

phrases.en: Wait a moment, please. Mommy is talking.

scenarios.title: 刷牙 & 洗脸
scenarios.tip: 刷牙是培养习惯的关键期场景。可以边刷边唱 Brush brush brush，让刷牙变成游戏。每次都用同样的句式，宝宝很快能听懂并配合张嘴说 Aaaah。

phrases.en: Let's brush your teeth! Where is your toothbrush?
phrases.cn: 我们刷牙啦！你的牙刷在哪？

phrases.en: Open wide! Say Aaaah...
Brush brush brush. Up and down.
Rinse with water. Spit... okay!
Let's wash your face. Splish splash!
Shiny clean teeth! You did it!
phrases.cn: 牙齿闪闪亮！你自己刷好了！

zoo.title: 🦁 动物园专题 Zoo Animals
zoo.intro: 带宝宝逛动物园或看动物绘本时，先说动物名字，再模仿它的叫声和动作。宝宝对动物天然感兴趣，这是最容易建立的词汇连接。

animals.sentence: The lion says ROAR!
The tiger is big and strong.
The elephant has a long trunk.
The giraffe has a long neck.
The monkey likes to climb trees.
The panda eats bamboo.
The zebra has black and white stripes.
The hippo loves to swim in the water.
The crocodile has sharp teeth.
The penguin waddles on the ice.
The camel walks in the desert.
The kangaroo can jump very high.
The bear is sleeping in winter.
The wolf says howl.
The fox has a bushy tail.
The owl says hoo hoo at night.

outdoor.title: 🐦 路上常见的动物
outdoor.intro: 散步、去公园时遇到的小动物，是每天都能用到的自然英语素材。

animals.sentence: The cat says meow.
The dog says woof woof.
The bird says tweet tweet.
Look at the pretty butterfly.
The squirrel runs up the tree.
The snail is very slow.
The little ant is working hard.
The bee says buzz buzz.
The rabbit hops in the garden.
The little chick says peep peep.

一闪一闪小星星
How I wonder what you are

Up above the world so high

Like a diamond in the sky
像天上的钻石一样
Twinkle, twinkle, little star
一闪一闪小星星
How I wonder what you are

songs.d: 动作模仿神曲，配合转圈、按喇叭动作
lyrics: The wheels on the bus go round and round
公交车轮转呀转
Round and round, round and round
转呀转，转呀转
The wheels on the bus go round and round
公交车轮转呀转
All through the town
穿过整个小镇
The wipers on the bus go swish swish swish
公交车雨刷嗖嗖嗖
The horn on the bus goes beep beep beep

The mommies on the bus go shush shush shush

songs.d: 学动物叫声，认知动物的好帮手
lyrics: Old MacDonald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O
老麦克唐纳有个农场，咿呀咿呀哟
And on his farm he had a cow, E-I-E-I-O
他的农场里有头奶牛
With a moo moo here and a moo moo there
这里哞哞，那里哞哞
Here a moo, there a moo, everywhere a moo moo
到处都是哞哞叫
Old MacDonald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O
老麦克唐纳有个农场

songs.t: If You're Happy and You Know It
songs.d: 拍手跺脚，宝宝最爱跟着做动作
lyrics: If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands!
如果感到幸福你就拍拍手
If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands!
如果感到幸福你就拍拍手
If you're happy and you know it, and you really want to show it
如果感到幸福，并且想表现出来
If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands!
如果感到幸福你就拍拍手

songs.d: 身体部位认知第一神曲
lyrics: Head, shoulders, knees and toes, knees and toes
头、肩膀、膝盖、脚趾
Head, shoulders, knees and toes, knees and toes
头、肩膀、膝盖、脚趾
Eyes and ears and mouth and nose
眼睛、耳朵、嘴巴和鼻子
Head, shoulders, knees and toes, knees and toes
头、肩膀、膝盖、脚趾
Five little ducks went out one day
五只小鸭子有一天出去了
Over the hills and far away
翻过小山走远了
Mother duck said: Quack, quack, quack, quack
鸭妈妈说：嘎嘎嘎嘎
But only four little ducks came back
可是只有四只小鸭子回来了
Sad mother duck went out one day
伤心的鸭妈妈出去了
Mother duck said: Quack, quack, quack
鸭妈妈说：嘎嘎嘎
And all of the five little ducks came back!
五只小鸭子全都回来了！

songs.d: 可抱着宝宝前后摇，亲子互动满分
lyrics: Row, row, row your boat
划、划、划小船
Gently down the stream
缓缓顺流而下
Merrily, merrily, merrily, merrily

Life is but a dream

songs.d: 手指爬呀爬，精细动作+儿歌二合一
lyrics: The itsy bitsy spider climbed up the water spout
小蜘蛛爬上了水管
Down came the rain and washed the spider out
雨水落下来把蜘蛛冲走了
Out came the sun and dried up all the rain

And the itsy bitsy spider climbed up the spout again

songs.d: 节奏感强，全家都会上头
lyrics: Baby shark, doo doo doo doo doo doo
鲨鱼宝宝 嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟
Baby shark!
鲨鱼宝宝！
Mommy shark, doo doo doo doo doo doo
鲨鱼妈妈 嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟
Daddy shark, doo doo doo doo doo doo
鲨鱼爸爸 嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟
Let's go hunt, doo doo doo doo doo doo
我们去打猎 嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟
Safe at last, doo doo doo doo doo doo
终于安全啦 嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟嘟
One little finger, one little finger, one little finger
一根小手指
Tap tap tap!
点一点！
Point your finger up! Point your finger down!
手指向上指！手指向下指！
Put it on your head. Head!

songs.d: Super Simple Songs，洗澡时唱正合适
lyrics: Can you wash your hair? I can wash my hair!
你会洗头发吗？我会洗头发！
Can you wash your feet? I can wash my feet!

songs.d: 两声部简单旋律，起床/睡前都能用
lyrics: Are you sleeping, are you sleeping?

Brother John, Brother John?
约翰哥哥？

晨钟敲响了

songs.d: 可以两人搭桥让宝宝钻过去玩
lyrics: London Bridge is falling down, falling down, falling down

London Bridge is falling down, my fair lady
伦敦桥要塌下来，我美丽的淑女

songs.d: 旋律简单，跟着哼哼就会了
lyrics: Mary had a little lamb, little lamb, little lamb

Mary had a little lamb, its fleece was white as snow

songs.d: 拼字母+拍节奏，2岁+可以开始玩

B-I-N-G-O

items: 听到自己的英文名或 favorite toy 的名字会有反应（转头/看向物品）
能听懂简单指令：come here / give me / no no
听到 No 或危险的短句会停下动作
能听懂身体部位（如 Where is your nose? 会指）
喜欢听英文儿歌，会跟着节奏拍手或摇摆
偶尔模仿大人发音，比如 mommy、bye-bye
对人说 bye-bye 时会挥手
能听懂两步指令：Pick up the ball and give it to Mommy
能听懂日常场景句：Time to eat / Let's take a bath
会说 5 个以上英文词（如 bye-bye、ball、milk、no、more）
会指认绘本或实物中的常见物品（apple、dog、car 等）
听到熟悉的儿歌会哼最后一个字或跟唱关键词（如 BINGO）
能回答简单问题（Where is...? 会指；Yes/No 会点头摇头）
对英语有主动兴趣：主动要求放英文儿歌或拿英文绘本
能听懂三步以上指令
会用英文短句表达需求：I want milk / More, please
会唱 1–2 首完整英文儿歌
能进行简单一问一答：What's this? — It's a dog
认识常见颜色、动物、食物的英文说法（各 3 个以上）
能复述绘本里的关键词或句子
会主动用英语打招呼：Hello / Good morning / Bye-bye
